# Birmingham Medical News

> > Regional healthcare publication covering Alabama medical news, hospital systems, physician profiles, and healthcare business developments.

Birmingham Medical News serves Alabama's medical community with coverage of major healthcare institutions including UAB, Children's of Alabama, and Baptist Health, along with regulatory updates on HIPAA, Certificate of Need laws, and CMS policies. Part of a regional medical publication network extending to Arkansas.

## Key Topics

- UAB (University of Alabama at Birmingham)
- Children's of Alabama
- Baptist Health
- HIPAA compliance
- Certificate of Need (CON) regulations
- Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
- Alabama healthcare policy
- Healthcare business and practice management
- Medical innovations and surgical advances
- Price transparency
- Private equity in healthcare
- Women's health
- Diabetes prevention
- Hospital leadership
- Medical records management
